schema.sql: CREATE INDEX file_tbl_day ON file (tbl, day)

schema.sql: CREATE INDEX file_tbl_max ON file (tbl, max_ts)

schema.name: file
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE file ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tbl TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, rows INTEGER NOT NULL, min_ts INTEGER NOT NULL, max_ts INTEGER NOT NULL, level INTEGER NOT NULL, idx TEXT NOT NULL, u_shard TEXT, u_inc INTEGER, u_lo INTEGER, u_hi INTEGER, prec INTEGER NOT NULL, prec_lo INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: outbox
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: stream
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE stream ( shard TEXT PRIMARY KEY, incarnation INTEGER NOT NULL, watermark INTEGER NOT NULL, logged INTEGER NOT NULL, prev_incarnation INTEGER)

schema.name: tombstone
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE tombstone (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tbl TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: viz_schema
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE viz_schema (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), component TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, compat INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
